function family(r){const cs=new Set(r.countries||[]);const ms=new Set((r.legs||[]).map(l=>l.mode));const casp=(r.legs||[]).some(l=>l.edge&&l.edge.caspian);
 if(ms.has('air')&&r.legs.every(l=>l.mode==='air'))return {k:'air',n:'هوایی',seas:null,price:null,d2d:'Air Freight',risk:null};
 if(cs.has('TR'))return {k:'tr',n:'پل زمینی ترکیه',seas:'Turkey/Black Sea',price:'Turkey Land Bridge',d2d:null,risk:'Trans-Caspian/Middle Corridor (KZ-AZ-GE-TR)'};

 if(casp||cs.has('AZ'))return {k:'casp',n:'ترانس‌خزر / TITR',seas:'Trans-Caspian/TITR',price:'Trans-Caspian/TITR (Alashankou-KZ-Caspian-Iran)',d2d:'Trans-Caspian/TITR',risk:'Trans-Caspian/Middle Corridor (KZ-AZ-GE-TR)'};
 if(cs.has('KZ')&&cs.has('UZ'))return {k:'south',n:'جنوبی (ازبکستان–ترکمنستان)',seas:'Turkmenistan Transit',price:ms.has('road')?'TIR Direct (Central Asia Road)':'Southern (KG-UZ-TM-Iran)',d2d:ms.has('road')?'Road/TIR':'KG/UZ Southern',risk:'Southern Road (KZ-UZ-TKM-Iran)'};
 if(cs.has('KZ')||cs.has('TM'))return {k:'central',n:'کریدور مرکزی (خورگوس)',seas:'Central/Khorgos',price:ms.has('road')?'TIR Direct (Central Asia Road)':'Central (Khorgos-KZ-TM-Iran)',d2d:ms.has('road')?'Road/TIR':'Central/Khorgos',risk:'Central Corridor (Rail via KZ-TKM)'};
 if(ms.has('sea')||ms.has('short'))return {k:'sea',n:'دریایی خلیج فارس',seas:'Persian Gulf Maritime',price:null,d2d:cs.has('CN')?'Sea-Rail/Bandar Abbas':null,risk:cs.has('CN')?'Maritime Route (China-Bandar Abbas)':null};

function season(fam,month){if(!fam||!fam.seas)return null;const q='Q'+(Math.floor((month-1)/3)+1);
 const rows=DS.seasonal.filter(s=>s.cor===fam.seas);if(!rows.length)return null;
 const m=rows.filter(s=>s.q.startsWith(q)).sort((a,b)=>b.q.localeCompare(a.q))[0]||rows.find(s=>s.q.startsWith(Math.floor((month-1)/6)?'H2':'H1'))||rows[0];
 const u=m.util?mid(m.util)/100:.75;return {...m,u:clamp(u,.3,.98),s:m.sur||0}}
function famRisks(fam){if(!fam||!fam.risk)return [];return DS.risk.filter(x=>x.cor===fam.risk)}
const PR={'Very High':.9,'High':.7,'Medium-High':.6,'Medium':.5,'Low-Medium':.35,'Low':.2,'Very Low':.1};
const pnum=p=>{p=String(p);for(const k in PR)if(p.startsWith(k))return PR[k];return .4};

/* ---------- border crossing matching (border DB ↔ graph nodes) ---------- */
const XC=DS.crossings.filter(c=>c.lat!=null&&c.lon!=null);
const XCache={};
function crossFor(node){if(!node)return null;if(node.id in XCache)return XCache[node.id];let best=null,bd=1e9;
 const nm=(node.nameEn||'').toLowerCase().split(/[\s/(-]/)[0];
 for(const c of XC){const d=Math.hypot(c.lat-node.lat,(c.lon-node.lng)*Math.cos(node.lat*Math.PI/180));let s=d;
  if(nm&&nm.length>3&&String(c.n).toLowerCase().includes(nm))s-=.8;if(s<bd){bd=s;best=c}}
 const r=bd<.55?best:null;XCache[node.id]=r;return r}

 const m=s.match(/(\d{1,2})[:.]?(\d{2})?\s*[-–]\s*(\d{1,2})[:.]?(\d{2})?/);if(m){let a=+m[1]+(+m[2]||0)/60,b=+m[3]+(+m[4]||0)/60;if(b<=a)b+=12;return clamp(b-a,4,24)}return null}

/* ===== Route optimizer: multi-criteria label-setting Dijkstra + penalty diversification + data enrichment + Monte-Carlo + Pareto/TOPSIS ===== */
const OPT={o:null,d:null,w:{cost:40,time:30,risk:20,co2:10},modes:null,avoid:new Set(),month:new Date().getMonth()+1,maxB:6,k:10,res:null,sel:0,sig:''};
let EMC={key:'',m:null};
function edgeMetrics(C){const key=JSON.stringify([C.cargo,C.prefs&&C.prefs.modes]);if(EMC.key===key)return EMC.m;const m={};
 for(const e of C.G.edges){const x=yr([{edge:e,from:e.from,to:e.to}]);const l=x&&x.legs&&x.legs[0];
  m[e.id]={c:l?l.cost:e.distanceKm,h:l?l.runHours+l.waitHours+(l.dwellHours||0):e.distanceKm/25,k:l?l.co2:e.distanceKm*.02,
   r:.35*(1-(e.reliability??.8))+.25*(e.congestion??.5)+.12*((e.choke||[]).length)+(e.caspian?.08:0)}}
 const md=k=>qtl(Object.values(m).map(v=>v[k]),.5)||1;m.__n={c:md('c'),h:md('h'),k:md('k'),r:md('r')};EMC={key,m};return m}
class Heap{constructor(){this.a=[]}push(x){const a=this.a;a.push(x);let i=a.length-1;while(i){const p=(i-1)>>1;if(a[p][0]<=a[i][0])break;[a[p],a[i]]=[a[i],a[p]];i=p}}
 pop(){const a=this.a,t=a[0],l=a.pop();if(a.length){a[0]=l;let i=0;for(;;){let L=2*i+1,R=L+1,m=i;if(L<a.length&&a[L][0]<a[m][0])m=L;if(R<a.length&&a[R][0]<a[m][0])m=R;if(m===i)break;[a[m],a[i]]=[a[i],a[m]];i=m}}return t}get size(){return this.a.length}}
function dijkstra(C,M,o,d,w,pen,opts,trace){const G=C.G,N=M.__n,W=sum(Object.values(w))||1;const tr=C.rates.charges;
 const wc=w.cost/W/N.c,wh=w.time/W/N.h,wr=w.risk/W/N.r,wk=w.co2/W/N.k;
 const dist=new Map(),prev=new Map(),H=new Heap(),done=new Set();const s0=o+'|';dist.set(s0,0);H.push([0,s0,o,'']);
 while(H.size){const [dv,s,u,pm]=H.pop();if(done.has(s))continue;done.add(s);if(trace&&!trace.seen.has(u)){trace.seen.add(u);trace.order.push(u)}
  if(u===d){const path=[];let k=s;while(prev.has(k)){const p=prev.get(k);path.unshift(p.leg);k=p.s}return path}
  for(const e of G.adj[u]||[]){if(!opts.modes[e.mode])continue;if(opts.cE&&opts.cE.has(e.id))continue;const v=e.from===u?e.to:e.from;const nv=G.nodeById[v];if(!nv)continue;if(opts.cN&&opts.cN.has(v)&&v!==d&&v!==o)continue;
   if(v!==d&&v!==o&&(opts.avoid.has(nv.country)))continue;const mm=M[e.id];
   let c=wc*mm.c+wh*mm.h+wr*mm.r+wk*mm.k;
   if(pm&&pm!==e.mode)c+=wc*(tr.transferPerUnit||110)+wh*(tr.transferHours||18);
   if(nv.type==='border'){const x=crossFor(nv);const ch=(x&&x.clr)||nv.avgDwellHours||8;c+=wh*ch+wc*(nv.handlingCostUSD||150)+wr*cRisk(nv.country)*N.r*2}
   c*=(pen[e.id]||1);const ns=v+'|'+e.mode,nd=dv+c;if(nd<(dist.get(ns)??Infinity)){dist.set(ns,nd);prev.set(ns,{s,leg:{edge:e,from:u,to:v}});H.push([nd,ns,v,e.mode])}}}

function enrich(x,C,month){const G=C.G,fam=family(x),se=season(fam,month);const borders=[];let dH=0,flags=[];
 const units=x.d.units||1,kgU=x.d.kg/units,roadAdj=new Set();x.legs.forEach(l=>{if(l.mode==='road'){roadAdj.add(l.from);roadAdj.add(l.to)}});
 x.nodeSeq.forEach(id=>{const n=G.nodeById[id];if(!n||n.type!=='border')return;const db=crossFor(n);const clr=db&&db.clr!=null?db.clr:null;const oh=db?openHours(db.hs):null;
  const ohW=oh&&oh<24?(24-oh)**2/48:0;const delta=clr!=null?clr-(n.avgDwellHours||0):0;dH+=delta+ohW;const f=[];
  if(db&&roadAdj.has(id)&&db.gvw&&(kgU+19900)/1000>db.gvw)f.push('وزن ناخالص بیش از سقف '+nf(db.gvw)+' تن');
  if(db&&roadAdj.has(id)&&db.mh&&db.mh<4)f.push('ارتفاع مجاز '+nf(db.mh,1)+' متر');
  if(db&&C.cargo.reefer&&/^n/i.test(String(db.cold)))f.push('بدون سردخانه');
  if(db&&/clos|suspend|بسته|limited/i.test(String(db.st)))f.push('وضعیت: '+String(db.st).slice(0,40));
  f.forEach(t=>flags.push(n.nameFa+': '+t));borders.push({n,db,clr,oh,ohW,delta,f})});
 const qd=se?clamp(6*se.u/(1-se.u),0,96):0;dH+=qd;const sur=se?x.cost.freight*se.s/100:0;
 const cr=avg(x.countries.filter(c=>c!=='IR').map(cRisk));const fr=famRiskIdx(fam);
 const risk=clamp(.5*(x.risk/100)+.3*cr+.2*fr,0,1);const H=x.hours+dH,cost=x.total+sur;
 const fxp=(()=>{const P=fam.price?DS.price.filter(p=>p.cor===fam.price&&p.fx):[];return P.length?avg(P.map(p=>mid(p.fx)))/100:.05})();
 const r=rng(x.nodeSeq.join('').length*7919+x.legs.length*31),D=[],K=[];const cong=avg(x.legs.map(l=>l.edge.congestion??.5));
 for(let s=0;s<400;s++){let h=0;x.legs.forEach(l=>{const rel=l.edge.reliability??.8;h+=l.runHours*Math.exp(gauss(r)*(.05+.22*(1-rel)))+l.waitHours*(.4+r()*1.2)+(l.dwellHours||0)*(.7+r()*r()*(1.2+2*cong))});

  D.push(h/24);K.push(cost*(1+gauss(r)*fxp*.5)+Math.max(0,h-H)/24*45*units)}

 return {x,fam,se,borders,qd,sur,cr,fr,risk,H,cost,days:H/24,D,K,p50D:qtl(D,.5),p90D:qtl(D,.9),p10D:qtl(D,.1),p50C:qtl(K,.5),p90C:qtl(K,.9),onTime,flags,co2:x.co2/1000,fxp}}
function runOpt(C){if(!OPT.modes)OPT.modes={...(C.prefs.modes||{sea:1,short:1,road:1,rail:1,air:0})};const M=edgeMetrics(C);const o=OPT.o,d=OPT.d;const opts={modes:OPT.modes,avoid:OPT.avoid};
 const W0=OPT.w,vecs=[W0,{cost:1,time:0,risk:0,co2:0},{cost:0,time:1,risk:0,co2:0},{cost:0,time:0,risk:1,co2:0},{cost:0,time:0,risk:0,co2:1},{cost:1,time:1,risk:0,co2:0},{cost:1,time:1,risk:1,co2:1},{cost:2,time:1,risk:1,co2:0},{cost:1,time:2,risk:1,co2:0}];
 const trace={seen:new Set(),order:[]};const paths=[],sig=new Set();const addP=p=>{if(!p||!p.length)return false;const k=p.map(l=>l.edge.id).join(',');if(sig.has(k))return false;sig.add(k);paths.push(p);return true};
 vecs.forEach((w,vi)=>{const pen={};for(let it=0;it<(vi===0?5:2);it++){const p=dijkstra(C,M,o,d,w,pen,opts,vi===0&&it===0?trace:null);if(!p)break;addP(p);p.forEach(l=>pen[l.edge.id]=(pen[l.edge.id]||1)*1.7)}});
 (C.routes||[]).forEach(R=>{if(R.nodeSeq[0]===o&&R.nodeSeq[R.nodeSeq.length-1]===d)addP(R.legs.map(l=>({edge:l.edge,from:l.from,to:l.to})))});
 let cands=paths.map(p=>yr(p)).filter(x=>x&&isFinite(x.total)).map(x=>enrich(x,C,OPT.month));
 cands.forEach(c=>{c.feas=c.x.borders<=OPT.maxB&&!c.x.countries.some(k=>OPT.avoid.has(k)&&k!==C.G.nodeById[o].country&&k!==C.G.nodeById[d].country)});
 // Pareto on (cost, days, risk, co2)
 const V=c=>[c.p50C,c.p50D,c.risk,c.co2];cands.forEach(a=>{a.pareto=!cands.some(b=>b!==a&&V(b).every((v,i)=>v<=V(a)[i])&&V(b).some((v,i)=>v<V(a)[i]))});
 // TOPSIS
 const w=[W0.cost,W0.time,W0.risk,W0.co2],ws=sum(w)||1;const cols=[0,1,2,3].map(i=>Math.sqrt(sum(cands.map(c=>V(c)[i]**2)))||1);
 const Z=cands.map(c=>V(c).map((v,i)=>v/cols[i]*w[i]/ws));const best=[0,1,2,3].map(i=>Math.min(...Z.map(z=>z[i]))),worst=[0,1,2,3].map(i=>Math.max(...Z.map(z=>z[i])));
 cands.forEach((c,j)=>{const dp=Math.hypot(...Z[j].map((v,i)=>v-best[i])),dn=Math.hypot(...Z[j].map((v,i)=>v-worst[i]));c.score=(dn/(dp+dn||1))*(c.feas?1:.6)});

 cands.forEach((c,i)=>{c.rank=i+1;const ms=[];c.x.legs.forEach(l=>{if(ms[ms.length-1]!==l.mode)ms.push(l.mode)});c.modeSeq=ms;

 const cv=$('.op-map canvas',b);let anim=null,t0=0,hover=null;
 function proj(){const R=OPT.res;const ids=new Set();if(R)R.cands.forEach(c=>c.x.nodeSeq.forEach(i=>ids.add(i)));const ns=[...ids].map(i=>G.nodeById[i]).filter(Boolean);const P=ns.length?ns:G.nodes;
  let a=Math.min(...P.map(n=>n.lng)),z=Math.max(...P.map(n=>n.lng)),lo=Math.min(...P.map(n=>n.lat)),hi=Math.max(...P.map(n=>n.lat));const px=(z-a)*.12+2,py=(hi-lo)*.12+2;a-=px;z+=px;lo-=py;hi+=py;
  const k=Math.cos((lo+hi)/2*Math.PI/180);return {a,z,lo,hi,k}}
 let PJ=null;
 function draw(now){const {g,w,h}=canvasFit(cv);const P=PJ;const sx=(z=>{const W=(P.z-P.a)*P.k,H=P.hi-P.lo,s=Math.min(w/W,h/H);return {s,ox:(w-W*s)/2,oy:(h-H*s)/2}})();
  const X=(lat,lng)=>[sx.ox+(lng-P.a)*P.k*sx.s,sx.oy+(P.hi-lat)*sx.s];g.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const t=(now-t0)/1000;const cs=getComputedStyle(document.body);const line=cs.getPropertyValue('--line2')||'#444',faint=cs.getPropertyValue('--faint')||'#777',txt=cs.getPropertyValue('--text')||'#eee';
  g.lineWidth=1;g.strokeStyle=line;g.globalAlpha=.55;for(const e of G.edges){g.beginPath();e.pts.forEach((p,i)=>{const [x,y]=X(p[0],p[1]);i?g.lineTo(x,y):g.moveTo(x,y)});g.stroke()}g.globalAlpha=1;
  const R=OPT.res;const ord=R?R.trace.order:[];const sp=Math.max(1,ord.length/1.4);const shown=Math.min(ord.length,Math.floor(t*sp));
  for(const n of G.nodes){const [x,y]=X(n.lat,n.lng);if(x<-5||y<-5||x>w+5||y>h+5)continue;g.fillStyle=faint;g.globalAlpha=.5;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,1.6,0,7);g.fill()}g.globalAlpha=1;
  for(let i=0;i<shown;i++){const n=G.nodeById[ord[i]];const [x,y]=X(n.lat,n.lng);const age=t*sp-i;const a=clamp(1-age/(sp*.6),0,1);g.fillStyle='rgba(94,159,232,'+(.25+.5*a)+')';g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,2.2+5*a,0,7);g.fill()}
  const tp=Math.max(0,t-1.4);if(R)R.cands.slice().reverse().forEach((c,ri)=>{const i=R.cands.length-1-ri;const isS=i===OPT.sel;const prog=clamp((tp-i*.12)/.9,0,1);if(prog<=0)return;
   const segs=c.x.legs.map(l=>{const pts=l.edge.from===l.from?l.edge.pts:[...l.edge.pts].reverse();return {m:l.mode,p:pts.map(q=>X(q[0],q[1]))}});
   const tot=sum(segs.map(s=>s.p.length-1));let lim=tot*ease(prog),k=0;g.lineCap='round';g.lineJoin='round';
   segs.forEach(s=>{g.beginPath();g.strokeStyle=MODE[s.m].c;g.globalAlpha=isS?1:(hover===i?.85:c.pareto?.42:.18);g.lineWidth=isS?3.2:hover===i?2.4:1.6;if(isS){g.setLineDash([]);}
    s.p.forEach((q,j)=>{if(k+j>lim)return;j?g.lineTo(q[0],q[1]):g.moveTo(q[0],q[1])});k+=s.p.length-1;g.stroke()});g.globalAlpha=1;
   if(isS&&prog>=1){const all=segs.flatMap(s=>s.p);const L=[0];for(let j=1;j<all.length;j++)L.push(L[j-1]+Math.hypot(all[j][0]-all[j-1][0],all[j][1]-all[j-1][1]));const LL=L[L.length-1]||1;
    for(let q=0;q<4;q++){const d=((t*.18+q/4)%1)*LL;let j=L.findIndex(v=>v>=d);if(j<1)j=1;const f=(d-L[j-1])/((L[j]-L[j-1])||1);const x=lerp(all[j-1][0],all[j][0],f),y=lerp(all[j-1][1],all[j][1],f);
     const gr=g.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,9);gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');g.fillStyle=gr;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,9,0,7);g.fill()}
    c.x.nodeSeq.forEach((id,j)=>{const n=G.nodeById[id];const [x,y]=X(n.lat,n.lng);const end=j===0||j===c.x.nodeSeq.length-1;const isB=n.type==='border';
     g.fillStyle=end?'#fff':isB?'#E0A84E':'rgba(255,255,255,.8)';g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,end?4.5:isB?3.4:2.2,0,7);g.fill();
     if(end||isB){g.font='500 10px Vazirmatn';g.fillStyle=txt;g.textAlign='center';g.globalAlpha=.9;g.fillText(n.nameFa.replace(/^مرز\s*/,''),x,y-7);g.globalAlpha=1}})}});
  anim=requestAnimationFrame(draw)}
 cv.onmousemove=e=>{if(!OPT.res||!PJ)return;const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();const mx=e.clientX-r.left,my=e.clientY-r.top;const w=r.width,h=r.height,P=PJ;const W=(P.z-P.a)*P.k,H=P.hi-P.lo,s=Math.min(w/W,h/H),ox=(w-W*s)/2,oy=(h-H*s)/2;
  let bn=null,bd=12;for(const n of G.nodes){const x=ox+(n.lng-P.a)*P.k*s,y=oy+(P.hi-n.lat)*s;const d=Math.hypot(x-mx,y-my);if(d<bd){bd=d;bn=n}}

 function scatter(){const R=OPT.res,svg=$('.op-sc svg',b);const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();const w=r.width||500,h=r.height||260,m={l:54,r:14,t:12,b:30};
  const C2=R.cands;const xs=C2.flatMap(c=>[c.p10D,c.p90D]),ys=C2.flatMap(c=>[c.p50C,c.p90C]);const x0=Math.min(...xs)*.92,x1=Math.max(...xs)*1.05,y0=Math.min(...ys)*.9,y1=Math.max(...ys)*1.06;

  <div class="op-tl">${T.map(s=>{const w=(s.end-s.start)/tt*100;if(w<.15)return '';const l=s.kind==='leg'?x.legs[s.legIndex]:null;return `<i class="${s.kind}" style="width:${w}%;--c:${l?MODE[l.mode].c:'var(--line2)'}" title="${esc(s.kind==='leg'?nname(l.from)+' → '+nname(l.to)+' · '+MODE[l.mode].n+' · '+nf(l.distanceKm)+' km':nname(s.nodeId)+' · '+(s.label||''))} · ${nf((s.end-s.start)/24,1)} روز"></i>`}).join('')}</div>
  <div class="op-tlx"><span>${esc(nname(x.nodeSeq[0]))}</span><span>${nf(x.avgDays,1)} روز مدل · ${nf(c.days,1)} روز با داده‌ها</span><span>${esc(nname(x.nodeSeq[x.nodeSeq.length-1]))}</span></div>
  <div class="op-g2"><div><h5>توزیع زمان تحویل (مونت‌کارلو)</h5>${hist}<small class="sx-muted">سبز: تا سقف ${fa(C.prefs.maxDays||60)} روز · خط: میانه</small></div>
  <div><h5>اصلاحات داده‌محور</h5><ul class="op-adj"><li><span>کریدور داده</span><b>${esc(c.fam.n)}</b></li><li><span>فصل (${esc(c.se?c.se.q:'—')})</span><b>${c.se?'بهره‌برداری '+nf(c.se.u*100)+'٪':'—'}</b></li><li><span>صف ظرفیت</span><b>+${nf(c.qd,0)} ساعت</b></li><li><span>سورشارژ فصلی</span><b>${c.sur?usd(c.sur):'—'}</b></li><li><span>اصلاح ترخیص مرزی</span><b>${nf(sum(c.borders.map(b=>b.delta+b.ohW)),0)} ساعت</b></li><li><span>نوسان ارزی کریدور</span><b>±${nf(c.fxp*100,1)}٪</b></li></ul></div></div>

  $('.op-rfq',b).onclick=()=>{RFQ.src={x:c.x,name:c.name,fam:c.fam,days:c.p50D};view='rfq';render()};$('.op-trk',b).onclick=()=>{newShipment(C,{x:c.x,name:c.name,fam:c.fam},Date.now()+DAY);view='track';render()};$('.op-show',b).onclick=()=>showOnMap(C,R.cands,OPT.sel);$('.op-cost',b).onclick=()=>{COST.ext=R.cands.map(c=>({name:c.name,x:c.x,days:c.p50D,sur:c.sur,fam:c.fam}));COST.sel='o'+OPT.sel;view='cost';render()}}

const COST={sel:'r0',ext:null,inc:null,pay:'lc',duty:15,vat:10,fx:2,inv:18,broker:250,psi:true,ins:'A',ch:'green',month:new Date().getMonth()+1,season:true,unit:'total',dem:null};
const INC=['EXW','FCA','FOB','CFR','CIF','CPT','CIP','DAP','DPU','DDP'];
const SELLER={EXW:[],FCA:['origin','exp','psi'],FOB:['origin','exp','psi','thc'],CFR:['origin','exp','psi','thc','freight','fuel','peak','special','transfer','docs'],CPT:['origin','exp','psi','thc','freight','fuel','peak','special','transfer','docs']};
SELLER.CIF=[...SELLER.CFR,'ins'];SELLER.CIP=[...SELLER.CFR,'ins'];SELLER.DAP=[...SELLER.CIP,'border','last'];SELLER.DPU=[...SELLER.DAP];SELLER.DDP=[...SELLER.DAP,'imp','broker','duty','vat','dem'];
const PAY={tt:{n:'حواله (T/T)',r:.003,d:0},lc:{n:'اعتبار اسنادی (L/C)',r:.015,d:3},cad:{n:'برات اسنادی (CAD)',r:.006,d:1}};

const STG=[{n:'مبدأ',c:'#5E9FE8'},{n:'ترخیص صادرات',c:'#4FB9C9'},{n:'ترمینال مبدأ',c:'#6FA8DC'},{n:'حمل اصلی',c:'#A98BE0'},{n:'بیمه',c:'#E07FA2'},{n:'مرز و ترانزیت',c:'#E0A84E'},{n:'ریسک تأخیر',c:'#E97366'},{n:'ترخیص واردات',c:'#DE9255'},{n:'حقوق و مالیات',c:'#C9765B'},{n:'مالی و ارز',c:'#B49A6B'},{n:'تحویل نهایی',c:'#72BC8F'}];
const CAT={transport:'حمل',terminal:'ترمینال و جابه‌جایی',customs:'گمرک و مرز',tax:'حقوق و مالیات',finance:'مالی، ارز و بیمه',admin:'اسناد و خدمات',risk:'ریسک و تأخیر'};
function sources(C){const S=(C.routes||[]).map((R,i)=>({id:'r'+i,name:R.name,x:R,days:R.avgDays,fam:family(R),sur:0}));
 (COST.ext||[]).forEach((e,i)=>S.push({id:'o'+i,name:'بهینه‌ساز '+fa(i+1)+' · '+e.name,x:e.x,days:e.days,fam:e.fam,sur:e.sur,opt:1}));return S}
function landed(C,src,P){const r=src.x,c=r.cost,ch=C.rates.charges,val=+C.cargo.value||0,units=r.d.units||1;const se=P.season?season(src.fam,P.month):null;
 const days=(src.days||r.avgDays)+(CHN[P.ch].d)+(PAY[P.pay].d)+(se?clamp(6*se.u/(1-se.u),0,96)/24:0);
 const sur=se?c.freight*se.s/100:0;const exp=Math.min(c.customs,ch.exportClearanceUSD||120);const ins=c.insurance*INS[P.ins].m;
 const trans=c.origin+c.thc+c.handling+c.freight+c.fuel+c.peak+sur+c.special+c.transfer+c.border+c.docs;const cif=val+trans+ins;
 const duty=cif*P.duty/100,vat=(cif+duty)*P.vat/100;const demD=P.dem!=null?P.dem:Math.max(0,((r.maxDays||days)-(r.avgDays||days))*.35+CHN[P.ch].d*.6);
 const L=[['origin','جمع‌آوری و بارگیری مبدأ',0,'terminal',c.origin],['exp','ترخیص صادراتی',1,'customs',exp],['psi','بازرسی پیش از حمل (PSI)',1,'admin',P.psi?350:0],
  ['thc','THC و عملیات ترمینال',2,'terminal',c.thc+c.handling],['freight','کرایهٔ حمل اصلی',3,'transport',c.freight],['fuel','سوخت / BAF',3,'transport',c.fuel],
  ['peak','سورشارژ فصلی و پیک',3,'transport',c.peak+sur],['special','سورشارژ کالای ویژه',3,'transport',c.special],['transfer','تعویض شیوه / ترانشیپ',3,'terminal',c.transfer],
  ['ins','بیمهٔ باری · '+P.ins,4,'finance',ins],['border','عوارض مرزی و ترانزیت',5,'customs',c.border],['docs','اسناد حمل و گواهی‌ها',5,'admin',c.docs],
  ['dem','دموراژ / دیتنشن مورد انتظار',6,'risk',demD*(r.legs.some(l=>l.mode==='sea')?95:60)*units],
  ['imp','ترخیص وارداتی · مسیر '+CHN[P.ch].n,7,'customs',Math.max(0,c.customs-exp)+CHN[P.ch].c],['broker','حق‌العمل‌کاری',7,'admin',P.broker],
  ['duty','حقوق ورودی ('+fa(P.duty)+'٪ CIF)',8,'tax',duty],['vat','مالیات ارزش افزوده ('+fa(P.vat)+'٪)',8,'tax',vat],
  ['bank','کارمزد بانکی · '+PAY[P.pay].n,9,'finance',val*PAY[P.pay].r],['fx','اسپرد و انتقال ارز',9,'finance',val*P.fx/100],
  ['inv','هزینهٔ سرمایهٔ کالای در راه',9,'finance',val*P.inv/100*days/365],['last','حمل داخلی تا انبار',10,'transport',c.lastMile]]
  .map(([k,n,st,cat,v])=>({k,n,st,cat,v:Math.max(0,v||0)}));
 const sel=new Set(SELLER[P.inc]||[]);L.forEach(x=>x.who=sel.has(x.k)?'s':'b');
 const total=sum(L.map(x=>x.v));return {L,total,seller:sum(L.filter(x=>x.who==='s').map(x=>x.v)),buyer:sum(L.filter(x=>x.who==='b').map(x=>x.v)),days,cif,val,units,r,se,logistic:sum(L.filter(x=>x.cat!=='tax').map(x=>x.v))}}

 const S=sources(C);let src=S.find(s=>s.id===COST.sel)||S[C.E.selected]||S[0];if(!src){b.innerHTML='<div class="sx-empty">ابتدا یک جستجوی مسیر اجرا کنید.</div>';return}COST.sel=src.id;
 const seg=(k,o)=>`<div class="sx-seg" data-k="${k}">${Object.entries(o).map(([v,n])=>`<button data-v="${v}"${String(COST[k])===v?' class="on"':''}>${n}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;

  ${sl('duty','حقوق ورودی',0,55,1,'٪')}${sl('vat','VAT',0,20,1,'٪')}${sl('fx','اسپرد ارز',0,8,.5,'٪')}${sl('inv','نرخ سرمایه',0,40,1,'٪')}${sl('month','ماه',1,12,1,'')}
  <div class="sx-f"><span>نمایش</span>${seg('unit',{total:'کل',unit:'هر واحد',kg:'هر کیلو',pct:'٪ ارزش'})}</div></div>

  <div class="sx-card co-sk"><header><b>جریان هزینه: مرحله ← دسته ← پرداخت‌کننده</b></header><svg></svg></div></div>

 <div class="sx-card co-cf"></div></div>`;
 const P=()=>({inc:COST.inc,pay:COST.pay,duty:COST.duty,vat:COST.vat,fx:COST.fx,inv:COST.inv,broker:COST.broker,psi:COST.psi,ins:COST.ins,ch:COST.ch,month:COST.month,season:COST.season,dem:COST.dem});
 $('.co-src',b).onchange=e=>{COST.sel=e.target.value;rCost(b,C)};
 $$('.co-bar .sx-seg',b).forEach(sg=>$$('button',sg).forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{COST[sg.dataset.k]=x.dataset.v;$$('button',sg).forEach(y=>y.classList.toggle('on',y===x));upd(false)}));
 $$('[data-s]',b).forEach(i=>i.oninput=()=>{COST[i.dataset.s]=+i.value;i.nextElementSibling.textContent=fa(i.value)+(i.dataset.s==='month'?'':'٪');upd(true)});
 let cbMode='route';$$('.co-cbc button',b).forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{cbMode=x.dataset.v;$$('.co-cbc button',b).forEach(y=>y.classList.toggle('on',y===x));combos(true)});
 const U=(v,res)=>COST.unit==='unit'?v/res.units:COST.unit==='kg'?v/(C.cargo.weightKg||1):COST.unit==='pct'?v/(res.val||1)*100:v;
 const UF=(v,res)=>COST.unit==='pct'?nf(U(v,res),2)+'٪':COST.unit==='kg'?'$'+nf(U(v,res),3):usd(U(v,res));
 let res,raf=[];onClose(()=>raf.forEach(cancelAnimationFrame));hsCard($('.co-hs',b),C,r=>{COST.duty=Math.round(r*10)/10;toast('حقوق ورودی '+fa(COST.duty)+'٪ اعمال شد');rCost(b,C)});

 function kp(){const r=res;$('.co-kpis',b).innerHTML=kpi('هزینهٔ کل زنجیره',U(r.total,r),{pre:COST.unit==='pct'?'':'$',suf:COST.unit==='pct'?'٪':'',d:COST.unit==='kg'?3:COST.unit==='pct'?1:0,sub:'بهای تمام‌شدهٔ کالا (Landed): '+usd(r.val+r.total)})
  +kpi('هزینهٔ لجستیک (بدون مالیات)',r.logistic,{pre:'$',sub:nf(r.logistic/(r.val||1)*100,1)+'٪ ارزش کالا'})+kpi('سهم فروشنده · '+COST.inc,r.seller,{pre:'$',sub:nf(r.seller/r.total*100)+'٪'})+kpi('سهم خریدار',r.buyer,{pre:'$',sub:nf(r.buyer/r.total*100)+'٪'})
  +kpi('ارزش گمرکی CIF',r.cif,{pre:'$'})+kpi('زمان کل زنجیره',r.days,{d:1,suf:' روز',sub:'به‌ازای هر کیلو '+'$'+nf(r.total/(C.cargo.weightKg||1),2)});countUp($('.co-kpis',b))}
 function wf(soft){const r=res,L=r.L.filter(x=>x.v>.5);const tot=r.total;let cum=0;const order=[...L].sort((a,b2)=>a.st-b2.st);
  const sIdx=order.findIndex(x=>x.who==='b');const rows=order.map(x=>{const o={...x,s:cum};cum+=x.v;return o});
  $('.co-wfs',b).textContent=`${fa(rows.length)} جزء · انتقال مسئولیت هزینه در ${COST.inc}`;
  const h=`<div class="wf">${rows.map((x,i)=>`${i===sIdx&&sIdx>0?`<div class="wf-sep"><span>انتقال هزینه به خریدار · ${COST.inc}</span></div>`:''}<div class="wf-r ${x.who}" style="--d:${soft?0:i*32}ms" data-i="${i}"><span class="wf-n"><i style="background:${STG[x.st].c}"></i>${esc(x.n)}</span><span class="wf-t"><i style="right:${x.s/tot*100}%;width:${Math.max(.25,x.v/tot*100)}%;--c:${STG[x.st].c}"></i></span><b>${UF(x.v,r)}</b></div>`).join('')}<div class="wf-r tot"><span class="wf-n">جمع کل</span><span class="wf-t"><i style="right:0;width:100%"></i></span><b>${UF(tot,r)}</b></div></div>`;
  const w=$('.co-wfb',b);w.innerHTML=h;if(!soft)w.classList.remove('in'),requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>w.classList.add('in')));else w.classList.add('in');

 function sk(){const r=res,svg=$('.co-sk svg',b);const R=svg.getBoundingClientRect(),w=R.width||480,h=R.height||330;svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${w} ${h}`);

 function trend(){const f=src.fam;const svg=$('.co-tr svg',b);const pref=C.cargo.shipmentType==='LCL'?'LCL Consolidated':src.x.legs.some(l=>l.mode==='road')&&!src.x.legs.some(l=>l.mode==='rail')?'Road Truck':'FCL Block Train';

 $('.co-csv',b).onclick=()=>dlFile('landed-cost.csv',['جزء,مرحله,دسته,پرداخت‌کننده,USD',...res.L.map(x=>[x.n,STG[x.st].n,CAT[x.cat],x.who==='s'?'فروشنده':'خریدار',x.v.toFixed(2)].map(v=>'"'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(',')),'"جمع",,,,'+res.total.toFixed(2)].join('\n'));

/* ===== Container load-planning studio: extreme-point 3D packing + animated canvas 3D ===== */
const EQ={'20GP':{n:'۲۰ فوت استاندارد',L:589,W:235,H:239,kg:28200,tare:2230,eng:'20DV',door:[234,228]},'40GP':{n:'۴۰ فوت استاندارد',L:1203,W:235,H:239,kg:26700,tare:3750,eng:'40DV',door:[234,228]},
 '40HC':{n:'۴۰ فوت های‌کیوب',L:1203,W:235,H:269,kg:26500,tare:3940,eng:'40HC',door:[234,258]},'45HC':{n:'۴۵ فوت های‌کیوب',L:1356,W:235,H:269,kg:27700,tare:4800,eng:'40HC',door:[234,258],mult:1.12},
 '20RF':{n:'۲۰ فوت یخچالی',L:544,W:229,H:227,kg:27400,tare:3080,eng:'20RF',door:[229,226]},'40RF':{n:'۴۰ فوت یخچالی (HC)',L:1158,W:229,H:255,kg:26800,tare:4800,eng:'40RF',door:[229,250]},
 'FTL':{n:'تریلی ۱۳٫۶ متری (FTL)',L:1360,W:245,H:270,kg:24000,tare:0,eng:'40HC',door:[245,270],road:1}};
const ENG2EQ={'20DV':'20GP','40DV':'40GP','40HC':'40HC','20RF':'20RF','40RF':'40RF','OT':'40GP','FR':'40GP'};
const PAL=['#5E9FE8','#E0A84E','#72BC8F','#A98BE0','#E07FA2','#4FB9C9','#E97366','#C9B26B','#8FB0D9','#D98F6B'];
const PRESETS=[{n:'پالت یورو',L:120,W:80,H:140,kg:450,q:33,stack:true,rot:true},{n:'پالت استاندارد',L:120,W:100,H:120,kg:600,q:20,stack:true,rot:true},{n:'کارتن صادراتی',L:60,W:40,H:40,kg:18,q:300,stack:true,rot:true,tilt:true},
 {n:'بشکهٔ ۲۰۰ لیتری (روی پالت)',L:120,W:120,H:95,kg:880,q:10,stack:false,rot:false},{n:'صندوق ماشین‌آلات',L:240,W:160,H:180,kg:2600,q:3,stack:false,rot:true},{n:'کیسهٔ جامبو',L:100,W:100,H:120,kg:1000,q:18,stack:true,rot:true}];
const LOAD={eq:null,items:null,ci:0,yaw:-.62,pitch:.48,zoom:1,prog:0,play:true,speed:1,color:'item',auto:false,sel:-1,res:null,key:''};
function defItems(C){const c=C.cargo;const q=Math.max(1,+c.packages||1);let L=+c.L,W=+c.W,H=+c.H;
 if(c.dimMode==='cbm'||!(L&&W&&H)){const v=(+c.cbm||10)/q*1e6;if(v<.25e6){const s=Math.round(Math.cbrt(v));L=Math.round(s*1.25);W=s;H=Math.round(v/(L*W))}else{L=120;W=v>1.6e6?115:100;H=Math.round(v/(L*W));if(H>250){W=115;L=Math.round(Math.min(230,v/(W*250)));H=Math.round(v/(L*W))}}}
 return [{n:c.commodity?String(c.commodity).slice(0,30):'بستهٔ اصلی',L,W,H,kg:Math.round((+c.weightKg||q*500)/q),q,stack:c.stackable!==false,rot:true,tilt:false}]}
function pack(items,eq,maxC=14){const E=EQ[eq];const units=[];items.forEach((it,ti)=>{for(let i=0;i<it.q&&units.length<900;i++)units.push({ti,...it,stack:it.frag?false:it.stack})});
 units.sort((a,b)=>(b.stop||1)-(a.stop||1)||(b.stack?0:1)-(a.stack?0:1)||b.L*b.W-a.L*a.W||b.H-a.H||b.kg-a.kg);
 // non-stackable last so they sit on top? -> keep non-stackable first on floor? choose: heavy non-stackables first on floor
 units.sort((a,b)=>(b.stop||1)-(a.stop||1)||(a.stack===b.stack?0:a.stack?1:-1)||b.kg/(b.L*b.W)-a.kg/(a.L*a.W)||b.L*b.W*b.H-a.L*a.W*a.H);
 const cons=[];let rest=units;
 while(rest.length&&cons.length<maxC){const P=[],left=[];let eps=[[0,0,0]],wt=0;
  for(const u of rest){if(wt+u.kg>E.kg){left.push(u);continue}
   const ors=[[u.L,u.W,u.H]];if(u.rot)ors.push([u.W,u.L,u.H]);if(u.tilt){ors.push([u.L,u.H,u.W],[u.H,u.L,u.W],[u.W,u.H,u.L],[u.H,u.W,u.L])}
   eps.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]||a[2]-b[2]||a[1]-b[1]);let done=null;
   for(const p of eps){for(const o of ors){const [x,y,z]=p,[l,w,h]=o;if(x+l>E.L+.01||y+w>E.W+.01||z+h>E.H+.01)continue;let ok=true;
     for(const q of P){if(x<q.x+q.l-.01&&x+l>q.x+.01&&y<q.y+q.w-.01&&y+w>q.y+.01&&z<q.z+q.h-.01&&z+h>q.z+.01){ok=false;break}}if(!ok)continue;
     if(z>.01){let sup=0;for(const q of P){if(Math.abs(q.z+q.h-z)<.6){if(q.top!=null&&q.top!==''){const ov2=Math.max(0,Math.min(x+l,q.x+q.l)-Math.max(x,q.x))*Math.max(0,Math.min(y+w,q.y+q.w)-Math.max(y,q.y));if(ov2>0&&u.kg*ov2/(l*w)>+q.top){ok=false;break}}if(!q.stack){const ov=Math.max(0,Math.min(x+l,q.x+q.l)-Math.max(x,q.x))*Math.max(0,Math.min(y+w,q.y+q.w)-Math.max(y,q.y));if(ov>0){ok=false;break}}
       sup+=Math.max(0,Math.min(x+l,q.x+q.l)-Math.max(x,q.x))*Math.max(0,Math.min(y+w,q.y+q.w)-Math.max(y,q.y))}}if(!ok||sup<l*w*.72)continue}
     done={x,y,z,l,w,h};break}if(done)break}
   if(!done){left.push(u);continue}
   const b={...done,ti:u.ti,kg:u.kg,stack:u.stack,n:u.n,stop:u.stop||1,top:u.top,dg:u.dg||'',frag:!!u.frag,i:P.length};P.push(b);wt+=u.kg;
   eps=eps.filter(p=>!(p[0]>=b.x-.01&&p[0]<b.x+b.l-.01&&p[1]>=b.y-.01&&p[1]<b.y+b.w-.01&&p[2]>=b.z-.01&&p[2]<b.z+b.h-.01));
   [[b.x+b.l,b.y,b.z],[b.x,b.y+b.w,b.z],[b.x,b.y,b.z+b.h]].forEach(p=>{if(p[0]<E.L&&p[1]<E.W&&p[2]<E.H&&!eps.some(e=>Math.abs(e[0]-p[0])<.5&&Math.abs(e[1]-p[1])<.5&&Math.abs(e[2]-p[2])<.5))eps.push(p)});
   // project new EPs down to supporting surface (gravity)
   }
  if(!P.length)break;cons.push(stats(P,E));rest=left}
 return {E,eq,cons,unplaced:rest.length,total:units.length}}
function blocked(S){let n=0;S.P.forEach(a=>{if(S.P.some(q=>(q.stop||1)>(a.stop||1)&&q.x>=a.x+a.l-1&&Math.min(q.y+q.w,a.y+a.w)-Math.max(q.y,a.y)>1&&Math.min(q.z+q.h,a.z+a.h)-Math.max(q.z,a.z)>1))n++});return n}
function stats(P,E){const M=sum(P.map(b=>b.kg)),V=sum(P.map(b=>b.l*b.w*b.h));const cg=[0,0,0];P.forEach(b=>{cg[0]+=(b.x+b.l/2)*b.kg;cg[1]+=(b.y+b.w/2)*b.kg;cg[2]+=(b.z+b.h/2)*b.kg});cg.forEach((v,i)=>cg[i]=M?v/M:0);
 const nb=Math.ceil(E.L/50),dist=Array(nb).fill(0);P.forEach(b=>{for(let s=0;s<nb;s++){const a=s*50,z=a+50;const ov=Math.max(0,Math.min(z,b.x+b.l)-Math.max(a,b.x));if(ov>0)dist[s]+=b.kg*ov/b.l}});
 let floor=0;P.filter(b=>b.z<.5).forEach(b=>{let w=b.kg;P.forEach(q=>{if(q!==b&&q.z>b.z){const cx=q.x+q.l/2,cy=q.y+q.w/2;if(cx>b.x&&cx<b.x+b.l&&cy>b.y&&cy<b.y+b.w)w+=q.kg}});floor=Math.max(floor,w/(b.l*b.w/1e4))});
 const a=.12*E.L,bx=.86*E.L;const Rr=M*(cg[0]-a)/(bx-a);const ldm=Math.max(0,...P.map(b=>b.x+b.l))/100*E.W/240;

/* ---------- 3D renderer ---------- */
function shade(hex,k){const n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);let r=n>>16,g=n>>8&255,b=n&255;const f=v=>Math.round(clamp(v*k,0,255));return `rgb(${f(r)},${f(g)},${f(b)})`}
function heat(t){return `hsl(${lerp(200,0,clamp(t,0,1))} 65% 58%)`}
function scene(g,w,h,S,o){const E=S.E,P=o.P||[];const cx=E.L/2,cy=E.W/2,cz=E.H/2;const yaw=o.yaw,pit=o.pitch;const cyw=Math.cos(yaw),syw=Math.sin(yaw),cp=Math.cos(pit),sp=Math.sin(pit);
 const R=Math.hypot(E.L,E.W,E.H);const D=R*1.9/o.zoom,F=Math.min(w*.8,h*1.3)*1.9;
 const T=(X,Y,Z)=>{const px=X-cx,py=Y-cy,pz=Z-cz;const x1=px*cyw-py*syw,y1=px*syw+py*cyw,z1=pz;const sx=x1,sy=y1*sp+z1*cp,sz=y1*cp-z1*sp+D;return [w/2+sx*F/sz,h/2+(o.mini?6:16)-sy*F/sz,sz,sx,sy]};
 g.clearRect(0,0,w,h);const css=getComputedStyle(document.body);const line=css.getPropertyValue('--line2').trim()||'#555',text=css.getPropertyValue('--text').trim()||'#eee';
 const V=[[0,0,0],[E.L,0,0],[E.L,E.W,0],[0,E.W,0],[0,0,E.H],[E.L,0,E.H],[E.L,E.W,E.H],[0,E.W,E.H]].map(p=>T(...p));
 const quad=(ids,fill,stroke,lw=1)=>{g.beginPath();ids.forEach((i,k)=>{const p=V[i];k?g.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):g.moveTo(p[0],p[1])});g.closePath();if(fill){g.fillStyle=fill;g.fill()}if(stroke){g.strokeStyle=stroke;g.lineWidth=lw;g.stroke()}};
 // walls: decide which are far (back-facing to camera) → draw filled behind cargo
 const walls=[{ids:[0,1,2,3],n:[0,0,-1],floor:1},{ids:[0,1,5,4],n:[0,-1,0]},{ids:[3,2,6,7],n:[0,1,0]},{ids:[0,3,7,4],n:[-1,0,0]},{ids:[1,2,6,5],n:[1,0,0],door:1},{ids:[4,5,6,7],n:[0,0,1]}];
 const cam=n=>{const x1=n[0]*cyw-n[1]*syw,y1=n[0]*syw+n[1]*cyw,z1=n[2];return [x1,y1*sp+z1*cp,y1*cp-z1*sp]};
 const camPos=(X,Y,Z)=>{const t=T(X,Y,Z);return [t[3],t[4],t[2]]};
 const facing=(n,c)=>{const nc=cam(n),pc=camPos(...c);return nc[0]*pc[0]+nc[1]*pc[1]+nc[2]*pc[2]<0};
 const wc=[[cx,cy,0],[cx,0,cz],[cx,E.W,cz],[0,cy,cz],[E.L,cy,cz],[cx,cy,E.H]];
 walls.forEach((wl,i)=>{const front=facing(wl.n,wc[i]);wl.front=front;if(!front){quad(wl.ids,wl.floor?'rgba(120,120,115,.16)':'rgba(120,120,115,.07)',line,1);
   if(!wl.floor&&!wl.door&&i<5&&!o.mini){g.strokeStyle='rgba(140,140,135,.14)';g.lineWidth=1;const isLong=i===1||i===2;const n=isLong?Math.floor(E.L/20):Math.floor(E.W/20);
    for(let k=1;k<n;k++){const t=k/n;let a,b;if(isLong){const y=i===1?0:E.W;a=T(E.L*t,y,0);b=T(E.L*t,y,E.H)}else{a=T(0,E.W*t,0);b=T(0,E.W*t,E.H)}g.beginPath();g.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);g.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);g.stroke()}}
   if(wl.floor&&!o.mini){g.strokeStyle='rgba(140,140,135,.12)';for(let x=100;x<E.L;x+=100){const a=T(x,0,0),b=T(x,E.W,0);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);g.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);g.stroke()}}}});
 // CoG floor zone
 if(o.cg&&!o.mini){const zl=E.L*.1,zw=E.W*.1;const pts=[[cx-zl,cy-zw],[cx+zl,cy-zw],[cx+zl,cy+zw],[cx-zl,cy+zw]].map(p=>T(p[0],p[1],0));g.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,k)=>k?g.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):g.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));g.closePath();g.fillStyle='rgba(114,188,143,.13)';g.fill();g.setLineDash([4,4]);g.strokeStyle='rgba(114,188,143,.6)';g.stroke();g.setLineDash([])}
 // boxes → faces
 const faces=[];const L0=[.35,-.55,.76];const nL=Math.hypot(...L0);const n=P.length;const prog=o.prog??n;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const b=P[i];if(i>=Math.ceil(prog))break;let dx=0,dz=0,al=1;if(i===Math.floor(prog)&&prog<n){const f=prog-i;const e=ease(f);dx=(1-e)*(E.L-b.x+60);dz=(1-e)*30*Math.sin(f*Math.PI);al=clamp(f*3,0,1)}
  if(o.ex){dx+=b.x/E.L*o.ex*80;dz+=b.z/E.H*o.ex*60}
  const x=b.x+dx,y=b.y,z=b.z+dz,l=b.l,ww=b.w,hh=b.h;const ins=.6;
  const F6=[{c:[[x,y,z+hh],[x+l,y,z+hh],[x+l,y+ww,z+hh],[x,y+ww,z+hh]],n:[0,0,1]},{c:[[x,y,z],[x+l,y,z],[x+l,y,z+hh],[x,y,z+hh]],n:[0,-1,0]},{c:[[x,y+ww,z],[x+l,y+ww,z],[x+l,y+ww,z+hh],[x,y+ww,z+hh]],n:[0,1,0]},
   {c:[[x,y,z],[x,y+ww,z],[x,y+ww,z+hh],[x,y,z+hh]],n:[-1,0,0]},{c:[[x+l,y,z],[x+l,y+ww,z],[x+l,y+ww,z+hh],[x+l,y,z+hh]],n:[1,0,0]},{c:[[x,y,z],[x+l,y,z],[x+l,y+ww,z],[x,y+ww,z]],n:[0,0,-1]}];
  const base=o.colorFn(b,i);
  for(const f of F6){const ctr=[avg(f.c.map(p=>p[0])),avg(f.c.map(p=>p[1])),avg(f.c.map(p=>p[2]))];if(!facing(f.n,ctr))continue;const pr=f.c.map(p=>T(...p));
   const lit=.62+.5*Math.max(0,(f.n[0]*L0[0]+f.n[1]*L0[1]+f.n[2]*L0[2])/nL);faces.push({pr,d:avg(pr.map(p=>p[2])),fill:shade(base,lit),i,al,top:f.n[2]===1})}}
 faces.sort((a,b)=>b.d-a.d);const hit=[];
 for(const f of faces){g.globalAlpha=f.al*(o.dim&&o.dim(f.i)?.22:1);g.beginPath();f.pr.forEach((p,k)=>k?g.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):g.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));g.closePath();g.fillStyle=f.fill;g.fill();g.strokeStyle=o.hover===f.i?'#fff':'rgba(0,0,0,.28)';g.lineWidth=o.hover===f.i?1.6:.7;g.stroke();
  if(f.top&&!o.mini&&o.labels){}hit.push(f)}g.globalAlpha=1;
 // near walls wireframe
 walls.forEach(wl=>{if(wl.front)quad(wl.ids,null,o.mini?'rgba(160,160,155,.55)':line,1)});
 // door frame
 if(!o.mini){const dA=T(E.L,0,0),dB=T(E.L,E.W,E.H);g.fillStyle=text;g.globalAlpha=.55;g.font='10px Vazirmatn';g.textAlign='center';const dm=T(E.L,E.W/2,E.H+14);g.fillText('درب',dm[0],dm[1]);const fm=T(0,E.W/2,E.H+14);g.fillText('جلو',fm[0],fm[1]);g.globalAlpha=1}
 // CoG
 if(o.cg&&P.length&&!o.mini){const c=T(...o.cg),f=T(o.cg[0],o.cg[1],0);g.setLineDash([3,3]);g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.7)';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(c[0],c[1]);g.lineTo(f[0],f[1]);g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);
  const pul=(performance.now()/1000)%1;g.fillStyle='#fff';g.beginPath();g.arc(c[0],c[1],4,0,7);g.fill();g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(1-pul)+')';g.beginPath();g.arc(c[0],c[1],4+pul*9,0,7);g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.6)';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(f[0],f[1],6,3,0,0,7);g.fill();g.fillStyle=text;g.font='600 10px Vazirmatn';g.textAlign='center';g.fillText('مرکز ثقل',c[0],c[1]-10)}
 return hit}
function pip(p,poly){let c=false;for(let i=0,j=poly.length-1;i<poly.length;j=i++){const a=poly[i],b=poly[j];if((a[1]>p[1])!==(b[1]>p[1])&&p[0]<(b[0]-a[0])*(p[1]-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1])+a[0])c=!c}return c}

 b.innerHTML=`<div class="ld"><aside class="ld-side">

  const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();const pn=svg.closest('.panel')||document.body;const pr=pn.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(r.width<20||r.top<pr.top+4||r.bottom>pr.bottom-4||wrap||getComputedStyle(pn).visibility==='hidden'||document.body.classList.contains('fx-focus')||document.body.classList.contains('fx-noright')){if(el)el.style.display='none';return}
  ensure();el.style.display='block';el.style.transform=`translate(${r.left}px,${r.top}px)`;el.style.width=r.width+'px';el.style.height=r.height+'px';svg.style.opacity='0';

    $$('th',v).forEach(th=>{const i=+th.dataset.i;if(INT.sort===i)th.classList.add(INT.dir>0?'asc':'desc');th.onclick=()=>{INT.dir=INT.sort===i?-INT.dir:1;INT.sort=i;view2()}});
    const qi=$('.in-q',v);qi.oninput=()=>{INT.q=qi.value;const p=qi.selectionStart;view2();const n=$('.in-q',B);n.focus();n.setSelectionRange(p,p)};
    $('.in-csv',v).onclick=()=>dlFile(S.name+'.csv',[S.cols,...rows].map(r=>r.map(c=>'"'+String(c).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(',')).join('\n'))}})}
 function gsearch(){const q=(INT.gq||'').trim().toLowerCase();if(q.length<2){if(INT.tab==='gsearch'){INT.tab='over';rIntel(b,C)}return}
  B.innerHTML='<div class="sx-empty">در حال جستجو…</div>';lake().then(LK=>{const out=[];let n=0;
   LK.forEach(w=>w.sheets.forEach(s=>{const hits=s.rows.filter(r=>r.some(c=>String(c).toLowerCase().includes(q)));if(hits.length){n+=hits.length;out.push({w,s,hits})}}));
   B.innerHTML=`<p class="sx-note">${nf(n)} ردیف در ${fa(out.length)} برگه برای «${esc(INT.gq)}»</p>`+out.sort((a,b2)=>b2.hits.length-a.hits.length).slice(0,25).map(o=>`<details class="in-sec"${out.length<4?' open':''}><summary>${esc(o.s.name)} <small>${esc(o.w.name)} · ${fa(o.hits.length)}</small><button class="sx-btn sm" data-w="${o.w.id}" data-s="${esc(o.s.name)}">باز کردن برگه</button></summary>${tbl(o.s.cols,o.hits,20,INT.gq.trim())}</details>`).join('');
   $$('summary [data-s]',B).forEach(x=>x.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();INT.wb=x.dataset.w;INT.sh=x.dataset.s;INT.q=INT.gq.trim();INT.tab='raw';INT.gq='';rIntel(b,C)})})}
 ({over,cty,xing,cor,co,raw,gsearch,net:()=>netUpg(B,C)})[INT.tab]()}
